motivation: G8C verified trace supervision was the strongest prior directional signal (+4.667pp IID over final-only) but used extra trace tokens/FLOPs and did not isolate chronology. G18P training-only workspace supervision produced no exact gain and worse answer NLL, suggesting auxiliary states that are not themselves causally generated are insufficient. Test whether a compute-matched, autoregressively generated four-state trace helps specifically because of chronological order rather than merely extra tokens/state values.

hypotheses.H19a: Ordered causal trace improves arithmetic+code IID exact by >=3.0pp over same-length noop-trace control.
hypotheses.H19b: Ordered causal trace improves arithmetic+code IID exact by >=2.0pp over same-multiset numerically sorted bag-trace control.
hypotheses.H19c: Ordered-vs-noop reasoning+code direction is positive in both fixed seeds, ordered-vs-bag positive in at least one seed, and memory+list IID regression is no worse than 3.0pp.

output_contract: All arms generate exactly T=s1,s2,s3,s4;F=d then EOS. Noop uses x,x,x,x; bag uses the exact same four gold state values sorted numerically during training; ordered uses chronological states. At inference every arm receives prompt only and must generate its own trace and answer.

training.optimizer: AdamW lr .001 warmup10 cosine-to10%, betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1

scoring: Prompt-only greedy free generation first; parser sees generated text only. EOS/strict T=...;F=d syntax recorded. Gold/case objects are used only after generation for scoring. Report free exact, exact trace, final-digit NLL, surface/extrapolation, counterfactual both-correct/query sensitivity, wall time, total params, checkpoint hashes, reload and deterministic next-update replay.
interpretation: Mechanism pilot only. Passing gates would justify scaling the causal trace mechanism, not establish broad reasoning, Qwen parity, or the 300-800M target.
engineering_smoke: A local 5-step one-seed smoke was used only to validate execution/reload mechanics; it is not a registered research result and is excluded from all claims.
